keyPhrases.text: I knew it was bullshit within minutes
should have never made it past the rehearsal room
If there was a Tony Award for Fraudulent Performance by an A-lister in a Play, Brody would have it on lock
There are standouts in this 12-person cast
most moving performance of the play
could melt the heart of even the coldest prison warden

reasoning: Harsh criticism of lead performance dominates review with scathing language about Brody's 'fraudulent' acting. While some supporting cast and technical elements receive praise, the overwhelming tone is negative with strong disapproval of the central elements.
